_about: English UI strings for the K-12 grade-band screens. Another language is a file with the same keys (for example fr.json); missing keys fall back to English. {name}-style words are filled in by the app.

verbs.ask: Your AI tutor: ask questions, get explanations, practice

discover.title: Music Coding
discover.text: Make a song by snapping blocks together.

explore.title: Block Puzzles: Maze
explore.text: Guide the character to the goal with blocks.

build.title: Data and Patterns
build.text: AI Foundations, Lesson 2: how AI finds patterns in data.

launch.title: While Loops
launch.text: Python Foundations, Lesson 7: loops that run until a condition changes.

play.label: Play
play.say: Play. Games where you make things with blocks.

ask.label: Ask
ask.say: Ask. Ask your helper a question.

stars.label: My Stars
stars.say: My Stars. See the stars you have earned.

login.studentText: Sign in with the username and password or PIN from your teacher.
login.staffText: Teachers, counselors and administrators sign in with their school account.
login.studentForgot: Forgot your password? Ask your teacher. They can make you a new one.
login.staffForgot: Forgot your password? Ask your school's administrator to reset it.

school.title: School
school.subtitle: Your school by grade, then class, then student. Open a student to see their progress.
school.noStudents: No students in your classes yet.

widen.title: Content
widen.text: {name} sees the courses, games and library shelves for {band}. You can open up other bands too. The tutor's rules and safety checks stay the same.

projects.title: Projects
projects.handedInNote: Handed in. Your teacher can read it now.
projects.saveFirst: Save your work first, then hand it in.
projects.changedNote: You changed it after handing it in. Hand it in again when you are ready.
projects.helperText: Stuck? Ask the helper. It gives hints and questions, not the answers.

practice.gradeText: Practice sets from your grade's courses. Answers are checked right away, with hints when you need them.
practice.pythonText: Questions, flashcards and a sprint on the Python you have learned.
